articles.title: Male stabbed in Thorncliffe Park
articles.summary: A male has been rushed to hospital after being stabbed in Thorncliffe Park. Toronto police were called to Overlea Boulevard and Thorncliffe Park Drive just after 8:30 p.m. Officers found a male suffering from stab wounds outdoors in the area, police say. He was taken to hospital by emergency run with non-life-threatening injuries. No suspect […]

articles.title: Petition calls for traffic lights to replace crosswalk in North York neighbourhood where child was struck
articles.summary: Nearly two weeks after an eight-year-old girl and her grandmother were struck by a vehicle in a North York neighbourhood, residents are bringing their concerns about the crosswalk where the collision happened to Toronto City Hall. Those in East Willowdale say the crosswalk is a safety hazard, telling CityNews drivers often blast through the pedestrian crossover even […]

articles.title: Pedestrian struck by vehicle in Mississauga
articles.summary: A pedestrian has been taken to hospital after being struck by a vehicle in Mississauga. Peel police say the collision occurred just after 3:30 p.m. Monday in the area of Burnhamthorpe Road and Duke of York Boulevard. The vehicle struck the pedestrian and subsequently struck a pole, police say. The driver involved remained on the […]

articles.title: Canada and China sign deal to deepen financial sector ties
articles.summary: VANCOUVER — Canada and China have struck an agreement to deepen collaboration across their financial systems as the two countries seek closer economic ties.

articles.title: Stellantis signs deal with Roshel to sell Brampton assembly plant
articles.summary: Stellantis says it has officially signed an agreement with defence contractor Roshel to sell its idled Brampton assembly plant. Under the asset purchase agreement, Roshel will acquire the facility and associated equipment from the automaker for an undisclosed amount. The companies said in a joint news release they are also exploring future collaboration opportunities across […]

articles.title: Ajax swimming supervisor facing charges in alleged sexual assault of youth employee
articles.summary: An Ajax swimming supervisor has been charged after allegedly sexually assaulting a youth employee. Durham police say the investigation began after allegations were made against a 20-year-old male supervisor at Aqua-Tots in Ajax. articles.title: Roshel to buy Stellantis assembly plant in Brampton for undisclosed amount, automaker says
articles.summary: Canadian armoured vehicle maker Roshel Inc. will buy the Stellantis assembly plant in Brampton, Ont., the automaker announced Monday.

articles.title: Ajax, Pickering casino workers back to work after ratifying new collective agreement with employer
articles.summary: Hundreds of workers from Casino Ajax and Pickering Casino Resort who have been on strike since the end of July are back at work after ratifying a new collective agreement with Great Canadian Entertainment.

articles.title: 3 teens charged after fire at former Habitat for Humanity ReStore building in Milton: police
articles.summary: Following an investigation into a fire in Milton Sunday evening, three 14-year-olds have each been charged with one count of break and enter and one count of arson, police say.

articles.title: Suspicious tree removal and permits linked to Toronto developer
articles.summary: A Toronto developer is facing new accusations of illegal tree removal at a residential property in Etobicoke. Four trees were recently cut down without permits at a property connected to Modcity. The company denies any wrongdoing.

articles.title: Thousands gather for major Diwali celebration in Brampton
articles.summary: Thousands of people from across the GTA gathered in Brampton on Sunday for the city's annual Diwali Mela, marking the Hindu Festival for the fourth consecutive year.

articles.title: Workers rally against potential layoffs at Etobicoke nursing home
articles.summary: A group of unionized long-term care workers rallied in Etobicoke Saturday to sound the alarm over potential layoffs and staffing shortages.

articles.title: Police identify 18-year-old victim of fatal Etobicoke shooting
articles.summary: Toronto police have identified the victim of a homicide in Etobicoke on Saturday. Malik Abass, 18, of Mississauga, was shot in the area of Rathburn Road and The East Mall, the Toronto Police Service said in a news release Sunday.

articles.title: York University warns of personal data theft in cybersecurity incident
articles.summary: York University is warning the community of a cybersecurity incident that resulted in the theft of personal information, including personal contact details and student identification numbers.

articles.title: An Ontario nature sanctuary home to over 70 rare species will now be protected for generations to come
articles.summary: A nature sanctuary in Whitby, Ont., home to over 70 rare species, some of which are at-risk, is now part of the Ontario Nature reserve system after its acquisition of the forested area from its previous land trust owners last week.
